summary: Microsoft amended its January disclosure to report that the nation-state threat actor used information taken from employee emails to access, or attempt to access, some of its source code repositories and internal systems, that the attack is ongoing and sustained, and that further unauthorized access may occur; no material operational or financial impact had yet been determined.
new_vs_prior: New since the January 19, 2024 filing: the threat actor used the exfiltrated email information to gain or attempt unauthorized access to Microsoft source code repositories and internal systems; the attack is described as ongoing, sustained, and significant, with further unauthorized access possible; Microsoft has increased security investments and coordination; the earlier containment claim (access removed on or about January 13) is no longer repeated and coordination is now with federal law enforcement.
